methodologyNotes: Roster covers 12 countertop electric composters/food recyclers a US buyer is likely comparing in 2026, spanning 8 brands: Lomi (Pela), FoodCycler by Vitamix, Reencle, Mill, Vego Garden, Airthereal, Tero, and GEME. Seeds were independently verified against official manufacturer pages and, where those blocked automated access, reputable retailer/press/review sources. Two seed corrections: (1) 'Vitamix FoodCycler FC-50' is discontinued as of 2026 (confirmed via foodcycler.com, which lists only Eco 3 and Eco 5) and was replaced with the current direct successor, FoodCycler Eco 3; FC-30 is likewise retired and omitted. (2) 'Beko b300' does not exist as an electric composter -- Beko's b300 nomenclature belongs to an unrelated oven/dryer/washer series, and no composter of that name could be found on Beko's corporate or Turkish sites -- it was replaced with GEME, a real, currently-shipping competitor (899.99 USD flagship + a notable August-2026 pre-order model, Terra 2) that appears repeatedly in 2026 head-to-head comparisons against Lomi/Mill/Reencle/Vitamix. Lomi's lineup was corrected/clarified: Lomi 1 branding has been superseded, so the two current, separately-sold SKUs (Lomi 2 and Lomi 3) are listed instead of a single generic 'Lomi'. Several official DTC storefronts (lomi.com, reencle.co, vegogarden.com/vego.com, airthereal.com, teroproducts.com/teroinnovation.com) returned HTTP 429 bot-protection blocks or an expired TLS cert to automated fetches throughout research; for those specific product pages, figures were cross-checked against cached search excerpts of the same official pages plus independent reputable secondary sources (brand Amazon storefronts, Costco/Home Depot listings, GlobeNewswire/PRNewswire launch releases, and detailed hands-on reviews from The Gadgeteer, Techlicious, dobbernationloves, Best Health, and similar outlets) and this fallback is flagged per-product in provenance. priceUsd is the current US starting price for the base standalone unit (no subscription bundling); subscription-discounted or bundle pricing is noted in priceNote. dimensions_in strings preserve each source's own axis order/labels where given. power_watts for Mill was arithmetically derived from its published 120V/4.5A rating (P=V*I); this is noted in its provenance. bucket_dishwasher_safe for the two FoodCycler Eco models is inferred from the dishwasher-safe bucket being a confirmed, consistently marketed feature of the entire FoodCycler line (explicitly confirmed for the predecessor FC-50 on vitamix.com) rather than re-confirmed verbatim on each Eco page; this inference is flagged in provenance. Every other null in this dataset means the figure could not be verified from any source found -- it is not a placeholder. IMAGE discipline: no Wikimedia Commons images exist for any product in this category (searched and confirmed empty for all 8 brands). Every image included was located by fetching the manufacturer's own product page, decoding its Next.js/Shopify asset path, and visually confirming (by rendering the downloaded file) that it depicts the exact named product, before recording the direct file URL, per-image accessedAt 2026-08-01. Where no manufacturer image could be retrieved (bot-blocked storefronts) or a candidate could not be visually confirmed as the correct product, the image field was omitted rather than guessed -- this affects Lomi 2, Lomi 3, Reencle Prime, Vego, both Airthereal SKUs, and Tero.

products.name: Reencle Prime
products.priceNote: $499 standalone MSRP (frequently promoted ~$429); bundles with sifter/accessories run up to $549.

specs.dimensions_in: 12 x 13 x 18.4 (D x W x H)

products.provenance: reencle.co (official) returned HTTP 429 (bot protection) on every direct-fetch attempt. Specs cross-checked from Reencle's Amazon storefront listing (14L, up to 2.2 lb/day, whisper-quiet), The Gadgeteer's hands-on review (28 dB, 1.25 kWh/day, ~$2/month electricity, 20.1 lb / 9.12 kg, 3-layer filter), and Mumsnet/Techlicious reviews for dimensions. Reencle uses live microbial decomposition (not dehydration), so unlike the dehydrator-type composters in this dataset it does not publish a 'volume reduction %' figure and there is no confirmed guidance on dishwasher-safety of the drum (a live-culture bin is generally hand-washed to protect the microbes) -- both left null rather than assumed. Power in watts not published (only daily kWh). Release date not confirmed to a specific year. Verified 2026-08-01.

products.name: Mill Essential
products.priceNote: $999 outright, or $84/mo over 12 months at 0% APR; optional Mill Pickup service adds $192+tax/year. The larger Mill Plus (same capacity, taller enclosure) is $1,149.

specs.dimensions_in: 23 x 17 x 14 (H x W x D)

products.provenance: Directly fetched from mill.com's official food-recycler page: Mill Essential (45 lb / 20.41 kg, 23x17x14 in) vs Mill Plus (56 lb, 27x17x14 in), both 6.5L bucket, 120V~/60Hz/4.5A. power_watts (540W) is arithmetically derived from the published 120V x 4.5A rating (Mill does not itself publish a watt figure). 42 dB noise level and 80% volume reduction corroborated via support.mill.com and independent press reviews (Reviewed.com). Mill runs continuously/overnight rather than a fixed cycle, so cycle_time_hours is descriptive rather than numeric. Carbon-filter presence and dishwasher-safety of the bucket are not stated by Mill in any source found -- left null. Image confirmed by downloading and visually inspecting the file: matches the white Mill bin with 'mill' branding. Verified 2026-08-01.

products.name: GEME Composter
products.priceNote: $899.99 official kit price (composter + 6-month Kobold microbe supply + shovel/scraper + 2-year warranty); Walmart has listed it at $854.99.
products.provenance: Directly fetched from geme.bio's official GEME product page: 19L capacity (5 kg/day), 6-8 hour cycle for most food scraps, 35-45 dB ('quietest composter on the market' claim), 19.5 kg, 320x455x665mm, permanent metal-ion catalytic-oxidation filter (explicitly NOT a carbon filter -- carbon_filter recorded false, a genuine differentiator vs. dehydrator-type competitors), 95% waste processed, no filter replacement needed, 2-year warranty. USD price corroborated via GEME's Amazon and Walmart listings ($899.99 / $854.99). This is the replacement chosen for the seed 'Beko b300,' which does not exist as a composter (see methodologyNotes). Watts and dishwasher-safety not published -- left null. Release date not published. Image confirmed by downloading and visually inspecting the file: matches the white/black GEME bin with lid open and compost spilling, GEME branding visible. Verified 2026-08-01.
